account.title: Account

password.title: Password
password.note: Your other devices are signed out and ask for the new password. Everything stays: favourites, history, subscriptions and guides.
password.done: Password changed. Your other devices will ask for the new one.
password.tooShort: Type your current password, and a new one of at least 8 characters.
password.mismatch: The new password and its repeat are not the same.
password.wrongCurrent: That is not your current password.

account.signOutNote: Signing out clears this device only. Favourites, history and channel order stay on the account.

subscription.title: Subscription
subscription.body: The provider's own login. Treat it like a bank card.

account.notSentBody: Changes made on this device have not reached the sync service yet, and would be lost. Press Sign out again to sign out anyway.

invites.title: Invite someone
invites.body: A code for one new account. It works once, for a week.
invites.made: Give this to the person you are inviting. On the sign-in screen they choose "Create an account" and type it in. Valid until {{date}}. It is not shown again.

tools.title: Tools
tools.body: Signed in with tvinto, the command-line tool, on a computer. A tool can change this account and set up its family. Adding, removing or resetting a member, and taking the lock off, it can only ask you for here.
tools.signOutBody: It will have to be signed in and allowed again before it can do anything more.
tools.notSignedOut: The tool was not signed out
tools.howWhat: Connect tvinto to an AI agent such as Claude and look after this account by asking: guides and channel matches, hidden and locked categories, sorting, player settings, recordings and the family. It shows you every change first, and nothing happens without your yes.
tools.howDesktop: Or, without Node: this app carries tvinto and runs it itself.
tools.howElsewhere: Set it up from a computer: these steps are commands to type there, in Tvinto's Tools on the computer.
tools.notCopiedBody: Select the command and copy it by hand.
tools.howSignIn: Sign it in. This app then asks you to allow it, with a code to compare:
tools.howNever: An agent can never change your password or see a provider login through it. Adding, removing or resetting a family member, and taking the lock off, it can only ask you for here.
tools.allowBody: It will be able to change this account's setup. Allow it only if your terminal shows the code {{code}}.
tools.allowBodyHistory: It will be able to change this account's setup, and see favourites and watch history. Allow it only if your terminal shows the code {{code}}.
tools.confirmBody: {{name}} is waiting for this confirmation in your terminal. Type it there, never into a website or another app: whoever has it can use this account's setup.
tools.notAllowed: The tool was not signed in
tools.signInFirst: Sign in to this app first, then run tvinto sign-in again.
tools.otherServer: That request is for another sync service than the one this app uses.
tools.gone: That request has run out. Run tvinto sign-in again.
tools.actionAddBody: Asked by {{tool}}. This app makes the password and shows it to you once; the tool never sees it.
tools.actionResetBody: Asked by {{tool}}. {{name}}'s devices are signed out. This app shows the new password to you once; the tool never sees it.
tools.actionNoMember: That member is no longer in the family.
tools.passwordBody: {{password}} -- write it down or give it to them now. It is not shown again.

display.title: Display size
display.body: How big text and everything else is drawn on this device. Other devices keep their own.

language.title: Language
language.body: The language of the app on this device.

login.leadSignIn: Your favourites and history, on every device.
login.leadRegister: One account for every screen. Your subscription comes next.
login.inviteHelp: From someone who already has an account: Account, then Invite someone.
login.inviteOptionalHelp: This server takes new accounts without one. A code from someone here puts you in their family.
login.notProvider: This is an account on this server, not your IPTV provider's login.
login.needInvite: Enter the invite code you were given

server.label: Server
server.help: A sync service you run yourself, for example on your own Cloudflare account. Your account and everything in it are kept there.
server.invalid: That is not a server address.
server.notReachedBody: {{name}} did not answer. Check the address, and that the service is running.
server.notSyncBody: {{name}} answered, but not as this app's sync service.

sub.lead: These are your IPTV provider's details, kept separately from your account. When they expire, enter the new ones here. Your favourites, arranging and history stay put.
sub.unreachable: Saved, but the provider could not be reached to confirm them. That usually means it is down for a while, not that anything is wrong with the details.
sub.sealed: Saved and sealed. Nothing on the server can open it, so nothing there can check it either. This device does that, the first time it asks for the library.
sub.label: Label
sub.noTls: This provider has no TLS at all. The username and password below travel unencrypted on your network.
sub.enterNewPassword: Enter the new password for this subscription.
sub.allNeeded: Server URL, username and password are all needed
sub.removed: Subscription removed. Your favourites and history are untouched.
sub.setUpForYou: Your subscription is set up for you. Ask whoever set up this account.

os.notSetUp: Adding subtitles from OpenSubtitles is not set up on this service yet.
os.pitch: Link a free OpenSubtitles account to add subtitles to films and episodes. Free accounts allow 20 downloads a day. Subtitles you add are saved to this account and appear on every device.
os.passwordNote: Saved to your account, encrypted, and only your devices can read it. They use it to sign in to OpenSubtitles for you.
os.asking: Asking OpenSubtitles how many downloads are left…
os.refused: OpenSubtitles no longer accepts the saved password. It may have been changed there. Link the account again to keep adding subtitles. Subtitles already saved still work.
os.unreadable: The saved OpenSubtitles login was encrypted with this account's old password, so it cannot be read any more. Link the account again. Subtitles already saved still work.
os.enterBoth: Enter your OpenSubtitles username and password.
os.useUsername: Use your OpenSubtitles username here, not your email: apps can only sign in with the username. It is shown on opensubtitles.com when you are signed in, under your profile.
os.usedUp: Today's downloads are used up. They come back at {{at}}, in {{in}}.
os.serviceUnreachable: The account service could not be reached. Try again.
os.serviceCouldNot: The account service could not do that.

problem.no-key: Subtitles are not set up on this service yet.
problem.bad-login: OpenSubtitles no longer accepts the linked login. Link the account again.
problem.rate-limited: OpenSubtitles asked us to slow down. Try again in a minute.
problem.unavailable: OpenSubtitles cannot be reached right now. Try again later.
problem.failed: OpenSubtitles could not do that. Try again.

os.notAccepted: OpenSubtitles did not accept that username and password.
os.wantsUsername: OpenSubtitles wants your username here, not your email.

subs.title: Subtitles
subs.sample: This is what a subtitle looks like.
subs.autoHelp: When a film or episode has subtitles in your language. Otherwise you can turn them on in the player.

picker.title: Subtitles
picker.linkHow: Adding subtitles needs a free OpenSubtitles account. Do it once on your phone or PC: Account, then Subtitles, then Link account. It is saved to this account, so this television will have it the moment you come back.
picker.savedStillWork: Subtitles already saved to this account still work.
picker.nextTime: They are used the next time this plays.
picker.timingHelp: If the words run ahead or behind
picker.byTitle: No id for this one, so these were found by searching its name. Check the year before you choose. A wrong match will run out of step.
picker.byIdFilm: Matched by {{source}} id. Results are for this exact film.
picker.byIdEpisode: Matched by {{source}} id. Results are for this exact episode.
picker.nothingHelp: Nothing matched that text. Provider names often carry tags OpenSubtitles does not know: 4K, MULTI SUB, a year, a language. Cut it back to the title alone.

epg.noDescription: The guide has no description for this programme.
epg.noGuide: No programme guide available for this channel.

player.noVideoTag: Your browser does not support the video tag.
player.startFailed: Failed to start playback. Press play to try again.
player.noHls: HLS is not supported in this browser. Use Safari, or the app.
player.loadFailed: Failed to load the video. Check that the address is right and reachable.
player.cannotDecode: This browser cannot decode this video: you will hear it but not see it. It usually means 4K or HEVC. The Android app plays these.
player.skipIntrosSub: Intros and recaps, where they are known
player.skipIntrosHelp: Button shows a Skip button during an intro or recap. By themselves skips it without asking. Only on episodes whose times are known: they come from TheIntroDB, a free shared database, and finding a show there needs TMDB.

guides.reading: Reading the guides on this device…
guides.title: Programme guides
guides.lead: Kept on this device, and used by the TV listing. No server involved.
guides.browserCannot: This build cannot load a guide of its own. A browser may not fetch one from another site, the same reason it cannot reach the provider directly. Use the desktop or the phone app.
guides.missingTitle: You use a guide this device has not got
guides.missingBody: {{label}} · added on another device. Nothing was downloaded here, because a guide is a large file and this device may be on mobile data.

skipped.one: {{count}} entry was skipped because its time or channel could not be read.
skipped.other: {{count}} entries were skipped because their times or channel could not be read.

guides.none: None yet. Add one below, or take your provider's.
guides.notLoaded: Not loaded on this device yet
guides.removeHint: Remove this guide and any channels mapped to it
guides.removeBody: Its programmes go from this device. It can be added again from its address.

mapped.one: {{count}} channel has been matched to a guide by hand. Removing a guide also removes the channels matched to it.
mapped.other: {{count}} channels have been matched to a guide by hand. Removing a guide also removes the channels matched to it.

guides.name: Name
guides.namePlaceholder: Taken from the address if left blank
guides.enterAddress: Enter the address of a guide
guides.noSubscription: No subscription is stored on this device to take a guide from
guides.notAnAddress: A guide address starts with http:// or https://, like http://example.com/guide.xml.
guides.emptyNotAdded: {{label}} answered, but with no guide in it: no channels and no programmes. Nothing was added; check the address.
guides.emptyKept: {{label}} answered, but with no guide in it: no channels and no programmes. The guide loaded from it before is kept.

cgp.title: Choose guide channel
cgp.noneUsed: No guide is being used for this channel.
cgp.noId: The provider gives this channel no guide id at all.
cgp.whyNothing: That is why the automatic match found nothing.
cgp.keeps: Choosing one keeps it for this account, on every device.
cgp.nothingResembles: Nothing here resembles this channel. Try searching for it by name.
cgp.marks: Provider marks like ⱽᴵᴾ and ᴿᴬᵂ are not in any guide. Try the name without them.
cgp.fine: Leaving this channel without a guide is fine.

arrange.showing: Showing {{shown}} of {{total}}. Moving a row still reorders the whole list, and saving keeps every item.
arrange.position: Position {{position}}. Press to type a new one
arrange.typeHelp: Enter a number and {{name}} moves there.
arrange.moveToRow: Move to a row's number, and type where it should go.

cat.chooseType: Choose a stream type to load its categories.

search.lookingThrough: Looking through {{library}}. A library this device has not searched before is fetched once, and they are done one at a time.
search.typeThree: Type three letters or more to search channels, films and shows at once.
search.nothingHelp: Search looks through what this device has browsed. A library you have not opened yet is indexed the first time you search it.

show.none: No episodes available for this season.

update.desktopHow: Restart to use it, or it installs itself once the app has been left alone for a while.
update.keepWatching: Keep watching; it is used once the app restarts.
update.webHow: Restart to use it, or it is used the next time the app starts.
update.appReady: Downloaded. Install it to get the newest version.
update.appManual: On this TV, install it once with the Downloader app from {{link}}. After that, updates download here.
update.appBrowser: Downloading in the browser. Open the file when it finishes to install it.
update.appSized: The newest player comes with the app ({{size}}).
update.appPlain: The newest player comes with the app.
update.allowInstall: Allow Tvinto to install apps in the screen that opened, then press Install again.

film.notOpened: This film could not be opened

discover.listFrom: From TMDB's list · only titles in your library
discover.end: That's every title on this list that your library has
discover.none: None of the titles on this list are in your library

trailer.title: Trailer
trailer.noYouTubeBody: Trailers open in the YouTube app. Install it from Google Play on this TV, and the Trailer button will work.

yourLanguages.title: Your languages
yourLanguages.order: Copies and trailers in this order: {{languages}}
yourLanguages.reset: Back to the app's language, then English

preview.heading: Guide
preview.title: Channel preview
preview.body: Plays the channel you rest on above the guide.

storage.heading: Storage
storage.banner: Tvinto is holding {{size}} on this device that it no longer needs.

failed.title: Couldn't free up space
failed.busy: The database was in use. Try again in a minute.
failed.full: There isn't enough free storage on this device to do it.
failed.unknown: Something went wrong. Nothing was changed.

slow.guides: Reading the guides on this device
slow.longer: This is taking much longer than it should.
slow.episodes: Asking your provider for the episodes
slow.guide: Opening the guide: reading this device's channel list
slow.popular: Finding this week's popular titles in your library

popular.from: From TMDB's list · only titles in your library
popular.looking: Looking further down TMDB's list · {{checked}} titles checked, {{found}} in your library
popular.endFilms: That's every popular film this week that your library has
popular.endShows: That's every popular show this week that your library has
popular.endDetail: {{count}} titles, from the first {{checked}} on TMDB's list. The list changes daily.
popular.noneFilms: None of this week's popular films are in your library
popular.noneShows: None of this week's popular shows are in your library
popular.noneDetail: Checked the first {{checked}} on TMDB's list.
popular.failedBody: Popular lists, artwork and film details can't be fetched right now. Everything you can play is unaffected.

activity.label: In progress
activity.sync: Bringing in your history and favourites

fy.guideComingDetail: What's on now will appear here when it's done.
fy.nothingYet: Nothing to resume yet. Once you have watched something it appears here, and so do the programmes on any channel you star.
fy.starHint: Star a channel, film or show and it appears here. Favourites, history and your category order follow the account to every device.
fy.starHintLocal: Star a channel, film or show and it appears here.
fy.onNow: On now on your favourite channels
fy.noGuideHere: No guide on this device yet
fy.noGuideAtAll: This device has no programme guide.
fy.upNext: Up next in shows you're watching
fy.byDate: by the date the provider added them
fy.popularWeekWhere: films and shows in your library
fy.accountUses: Your account uses {{label}}, which this device has not downloaded.
fy.withoutGuide: Without it there is nothing to say about what is on now. Your channels still play.

actions.guideMisses: For a channel the guide misses

section.nothingStarred: Nothing starred yet. Open a category and use the star on a card to keep it here.
section.customOrder: custom order, synced to every device
section.noNumbers: No channel numbers for this list.
section.guideEndsAt: The guide for this channel ends at {{time}}
section.noGuideForChannel: No programme guide for this channel
section.indexingChannels: Getting every channel for search, once a day…
section.indexingFilms: Getting every film for search, once a day…
section.indexingShows: Getting every show for search, once a day…
section.marks: Provider marks like ⱽᴵᴾ and ᴿᴬᵂ are part of a name on screen, not of the title. Try without them.
section.searchHelp: Search looks through every category. {{index}}. If it was added since, Reindex fetches the list again.
section.emptyHelp: The provider lists this category but returns nothing in it. Plenty of theirs are like this. It is not a fault at your end.
section.notIndexed: Not indexed on this device yet
section.otherVersion: "{{name}}" is in your library and will play here.
section.noOtherVersion: There is no other version of it in your library.
section.matchedByHand: Matched by hand. Change or undo
section.chooseWhich: Choose which guide channel this is

playback.recordingHolds: A recording is using your connection
playback.recordingHoldsHelp: Your subscription allows one stream, and a recording is using it. Stop the recording in Recordings to watch something else.
playback.cannotPlayThisFormat: This device can't play this format
playback.noDecoder: {{what}} is in a format this device has no decoder for.
playback.refusedHelp: It may be offline, or your subscription may not include it. Try again in a minute.
playback.unreachableHelp: Check this device's internet connection and try again.
playback.damagedHelp: The provider sent something the player could not read. Another version may work.
playback.behindHelp: Open it again to catch up with the broadcast.
playback.couldNotPlayHelp: Something went wrong in the player. Try again.

provider.noAnswer: Your provider didn't answer. Check the internet connection, or try again in a minute.
provider.refusedSignInHelp: The subscription may have run out, or its password changed. Check it under Account.
provider.gone: Your provider doesn't have it any more.
provider.troubled: Your provider is having problems right now. Try again in a minute.
provider.somethingWrong: Something went wrong asking your provider. Try again.

errors.serverUnreachable: Could not reach the server. Check the internet connection.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.signInAgain: Sign in again before storing a subscription: the key that protects it comes from your password

osd.noGuide: No programme guide for this channel
osd.closingFirst: Closing the old stream first - only one can play at a time
osd.turnedAway: The provider turned the first attempt away

catchUp.noAddress: The provider did not answer. Try again in a moment.
catchUp.needsDevice: Catch-up plays in the app on a TV, phone or computer, not in a browser.

age.title: By age rating
age.unrated: Titles with no age rating stay open, and that is most of an IPTV library. To keep those closed too, lock their category.
age.subject: {{rating}} · {{title}}

pad.remoteDigits: The number keys on the remote work too

account.title: Parental lock
account.offBody: Lock categories behind a PIN with the Hide and lock button on any list of categories. They disappear, with everything in them, until the PIN is given.
account.open: Unlocked on this device until it is left alone, restarted, or locked.
account.removePin: Remove the PIN and every lock
account.lockAfter: Lock again after this long untouched
account.removeHint: Asks for the PIN first. Hidden categories stay hidden.

providers.portalNeeded: A portal needs its address and a MAC address like 00:1A:79:12:34:56.
providers.macInvalid: That is not a MAC address: twelve hexadecimal digits, like 00:1A:79:12:34:56.
providers.title: Providers
providers.body: Your subscriptions and M3U playlists, as many as you like. With more than one, everything shows side by side, grouped under each one's name.
providers.replaceHelp: For a subscription that ran out. Favourites, history and guide matches stay with it.
providers.playlistHelp: The M3U address your provider gave you. It is read once and kept on each device.
providers.urlNeeded: The playlist address is needed, starting with http:// or https://
providers.confirmRemove: Remove {{name}}? Its favourites and history stay on the account.

carried.one: Replaced. {{count}} item (a favourite, history entry, order, guide match or hidden category) was moved to the new details by name.
carried.other: Replaced. {{count}} items (favourites, history, orders, guide matches, hidden or locked categories) were moved to the new details by name.

providers.replaced: Replaced. The new details number things the same way, so everything stays as it was.

family.settingUp: Setting up {{name}}. Nothing reaches their account until you press Save & Close.
family.kidNote: Everything on this account is set up by the people above it. You can watch and keep favourites.
family.leaveNote: You keep your account, favourites and history. Anything shared with you stops working.
family.title: Family
family.body: The people you set up. Each has their own account, favourites and history; you set up their subscription, guides and settings.

add.title: Add someone
add.passwordNote: Tell them the password. Members and admins can change it later; kids cannot.
add.badName: A username is 3 to 32 letters, numbers, dots, dashes or underscores.
add.done: {{name}} is ready. They can sign in with the username and password you chose.

roleNote.admin: Everything a member can do, and adding and setting up people of their own.
roleNote.member: Every setting of their own account, but not other people.
roleNote.kid: Watches and keeps favourites. Everything else is set up by you.

family.householdNote: People in your household are profiles to choose from when the app opens on your devices. Leave friends out.

subscription.title: Subscription
subscription.note: Most subscriptions allow one stream at a time, so two people on one interrupt each other.

guides.title: Programme guides
guides.mine: Same as mine, kept up to date
guides.note: Yours are copied to them with your channel matches, and copied again when you change them. Your provider's own guide goes only with a subscription you give them.

family.waiting: {{name}} has to sign in once before you can set up their subscription and guides.

open.title: Their account
open.note: Opens {{name}}'s account on this device to set it up. You see their setup, never their favourites or what they watch.

reset.title: New password
reset.note: For when they have forgotten theirs. They are signed out everywhere and sign in again with this one.

release.confirm: {{name}} keeps their account, favourites and history. You can no longer set them up.

delete.confirm: Delete {{name}} and everything on their account? This cannot be undone.

join.title: Join a family
join.body: Type an invite code someone gave you. They will be able to set up your account.

family.notReady: They have not signed in since they were added, so this cannot be set up yet.
family.switchNotReadyBody: This profile could not be checked for a PIN just now. Try again when the connection is back.
family.setupNotSentBody: The sync service could not be reached. Your changes are kept here; press Save & Close again when it can.

profiles.title: Who's watching?
profiles.notReady: {{name}} has to sign in once on their own before this device can open their profile.

describe.title: Descriptions
describe.body: Film and show descriptions as your provider sends them, or from TMDB in a language you choose. Episodes your provider left empty get TMDB's either way.
describe.notSetUp: This sync service has no TMDB key, so your provider's descriptions are shown. Add your own key below to get them from TMDB.
describe.attribution: This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.
describe.ownKeyBody: For a device without an account, or a sync service without a TMDB key. Free from themoviedb.org, under Settings, API. Kept on this device only.
describe.ownKeyPlaceholder: API key or read access token
describe.ownKeyInUse: Using the key typed on this device.
describe.ownKeyRefused: TMDB did not accept that key
describe.ownKeyRefusedBody: Check that it is the API key or the read access token from themoviedb.org, Settings, API, copied whole.
describe.ownKeyUnreachable: Could not reach TMDB to check the key
describe.languageHelp: Providers often send descriptions in another language. Choose one and Tvinto gets them from TMDB in that language. Needs a TMDB key: your own, below, or your sync service's.
describe.needsKey: This needs a TMDB key, which is free. Add your own below. Or sign in to a sync service that has one, and all your devices get it without typing anything.

picture.title: Picture
picture.matchRateHelp: The television switches to the refresh rate of what plays (50 Hz for European channels, 24 for most films), so movement is smooth. The screen goes dark for a moment when it switches.

recordings.clashBody: Your subscription allows one stream, and “{{title}}” needs it then.
recordings.portalBooking: A portal’s channels can only be recorded now, not booked ahead yet.
recordings.title: Recordings
recordings.lead: What this device recorded. Recordings stay on the device that made them.
recordings.notHere: Recording works on Android TVs and phones, and in the desktop app.
recordings.none: Nothing recorded yet. Choose Record in a channel’s menu.
recordings.recordHour: For an hour: the guide does not say when this ends

phoneForm.offer: Type it on your phone instead
phoneForm.offerHow: Scan the code with a phone on the same Wi-Fi. What you send fills the form here.
phoneForm.qrAlt: QR code to open the form on a phone
phoneForm.noKey: Scan the QR code on your TV again: this address is missing its key.
phoneForm.failed: The TV did not answer. Is the code still on its screen?

field.name: Name
field.key: API key or read access token

link.tmdb: Get a free key at themoviedb.org (Settings → API)

onboarding.welcomeLead: Your IPTV subscription on the television, phone and computer.
onboarding.providerLead: Xtream codes or an M3U playlist, from your IPTV provider.
onboarding.notFilled: Fill in the server address, username and password, or the playlist address.
onboarding.notReachedBody: {{host}} did not answer with its channels. Check the address, username and password, or try again in a minute.
onboarding.guideLead: What is on now and next, in the TV guide.
onboarding.startupLead: How the television opens the app.
onboarding.tmdbLead: TMDB is a free database of films and TV. A key from it gives Tvinto posters, descriptions, cast, ratings and what's popular.
onboarding.tmdbWithout: Without one, Popular and the film and show pages stay mostly empty. You can add it later on Account, under Descriptions.

startup.title: Starting up
startup.turnOn: Open when the TV turns on
startup.notAllowed: The TV does not let the app open by itself
startup.notAllowedBody: Allow it in the TV's settings: Apps, Special app access, Display over other apps, Tvinto. Then turn this on again.

local.title: No account
local.body: Everything is kept on this device and nothing is sent anywhere. Sign in to sync favourites, history and your setup with your other devices.
local.sub: Not signed in · everything stays on this device
local.firstLead: Your IPTV subscription or an M3U playlist. No account is needed; it is kept on this device.
local.needsSync: Needs a sync service: sign in to sync to use it.
local.notBroughtBody: This device's providers could not be given to the account, so nothing was changed. Everything is still here, without an account. Try again when the server can be reached.
local.signOutBody: Keep this device as it is, with its providers, favourites and history, and go on without an account; or remove all of it from this device. The account keeps everything either way.
local.bringBody: This device still holds what {{from}} kept when they signed out: their providers, favourites, history, guides and reminders. Bring all of it into {{name}}'s account, or start {{name}} with only what their account has.
